target_services.name: Xero
target_services.research_notes: Endpoint https://api.xero.com/mcp/v1. Core+ required for real organisations; accountant/bookkeeper API fee exemption may apply. Custom Connections ineligible. Grant only required tool scopes; writes require client-side confirmation. Read starter scopes: accounting.invoices.read accounting.contacts.read accounting.settings.read accounting.reports.aged.read; add offline_access for refresh. Scopes table: banking accounting.banktransactions.read; payments accounting.payments.read; manual journals accounting.manualjournals.read; reports granular. Canada accounting availability does not prove Canadian tax filing through API/MCP. Official remote MCP commercial-app Core+ entitlement; Starter demo only.
